task_intent: Redesign a website's side AI chatbot panel with avatar, suggested questions, and animated input.

data.query: AI chat assistant side panel docked to the right of a web app, with avatar header, suggested question chips and message input at bottom
floating chatbot widget opened from bottom corner launcher, empty state greeting with person avatar and suggested prompts
AI copilot chat drawer sliding in from the right edge over the page, conversation with assistant avatar next to replies and user avatar next to user bubbles
chat launcher button with person profile photo and label "Ask" floating in the bottom corner of a website
AI assistant chat bottom sheet with suggested question chips above the keyboard input and assistant avatar

references.title: HoneyBook
references.context: AI assistant docked over the dashboard.
references.observed: A rounded, nearly full-height panel floats over the right edge with a small gap. It has a header with history, expand and close icons, a long answer, feedback icons and the composer pinned at the bottom. The page behind stays visible.
references.adapt: The core drawer shape: inset from the viewport, rounded, non-modal, with the composer pinned to the bottom.
references.caution: It is dense for a marketing site. Keep the header to identity and close.

references.title: Linear
references.observed: A floating card in the lower-right with minimise, expand and close controls, and a reply field at the bottom.
references.adapt: Confirms that a corner-anchored panel can coexist with the page.
references.caution: The card is shorter than Mor wants. The drawer should use the full height.

references.title: HubSpot
references.observed: A full-height right drawer with a coloured header band. Every message shows an avatar and a name, with sources listed under the answer.
references.adapt: Full-height docking and a strong header.
references.caution: Avatars on both sides add noise. Keep avatars on answers only, as decided.

references.title: Zendesk
references.observed: A classic widget above a square launcher. Each bot bubble has an avatar, with a timestamp at the top and a focused input ring.
references.adapt: A small avatar beside each answer bubble.
references.caution: This is a generic support look. Moriz needs its own identity: photo, type and gradient.

references.title: Delphi
references.observed: A real person's photo and name sit at the top. Visitor messages are in a bold orange bubble, and answers are in soft grey bubbles written in the first person.
references.adapt: The closest analogue to moriz.ai: Mor's face in the header and a strongly coloured visitor bubble (brand yellow).
references.caution: It only works if answers really sound like Mor. That needs the first-person prompt tweak.

references.title: Aboard
references.observed: A popover chat where a portrait photo sits beside a person's bubble and a lettered avatar marks the other side.
references.adapt: A small round portrait reads well beside a bubble at about 28–32px.
references.caution: Use a well-cropped head, not the full cutout.

references.title: Resend Help
references.observed: The assistant's mark sits beside a two-line introduction ("I'm an AI assistant trained on…"), followed by "Example questions" chips and the input below.
references.adapt: The empty-state recipe: avatar, intro, chips.
references.caution: Keep the intro honest about the scope: answers come from Mor's own information.

references.title: Resend Help: thinking
references.context: The same assistant while it works.
references.observed: The visitor's question is echoed, then an "Analyzing" row appears with the assistant mark.
references.adapt: Echo the question at once and show a thinking bubble with Mor's avatar.
references.caution: Announce the state to screen readers once, not on a loop.

references.title: Bond
references.observed: The sheet header names the person with their photo. Suggested questions sit right above the input, and the input itself holds the person's avatar.
references.adapt: The mobile layout: suggestions above the composer, and identity in the header.
references.caution: A horizontally scrolling chip row hides options. Keep it to four short questions.

references.title: Origin
references.observed: A sparkle, a two-line headline and four tinted question chips are centred in a large empty canvas.
references.adapt: The centred empty state with tinted chips.
references.caution: The empty canvas is large. In a 26rem drawer, keep the greeting near the composer.

references.title: Deel
references.observed: A greeting, a scope sentence and a rounded input, with three suggested questions listed below the input.
references.adapt: A one-line scope sentence under the greeting.
references.caution: This is a full-page layout. Only the empty-state recipe applies.

references.title: Otter AI
references.observed: Full-width suggestion cards, each with a sparkle icon, are centred above a rounded input.
references.adapt: Full-width, wrapped question cards suit longer Hebrew questions better than pills.
references.caution: The cards take space. They collapse once the conversation starts.

references.title: Base44
references.observed: Mid-conversation, a "Suggestions" row stays under the composer, and the assistant name and avatar head each answer.
references.adapt: Keep the questions not yet asked available after the first answer.
references.caution: Keep the row quiet so it doesn't compete with the thread.

references.title: Jobber
references.observed: A dark surface with an intro and topic chips. The input has a multi-colour gradient border glow.
references.adapt: A slow conic-gradient ring in red and yellow on the composer, brighter on focus.
references.caution: Keep the ring thin. The text field still needs a clear, accessible focus indicator.

references.title: Cleo
references.observed: A soft peach-to-white gradient wash fills the chat. Quick-reply chips sit above the input, and visitor bubbles are white.
references.adapt: Low-opacity brand blobs that drift slowly behind the header and empty state.
references.caution: Fade the wash out behind the message list so contrast stays high, especially in dark mode.

method.download: curl -L from each image_url; verified with `file` as WebP

groups.persona: Person as assistant identity, avatars, thinking state

exclusions: Full-page AI apps with sidebars (Claude, ChatGPT, Notion, WRITER, Devin, Langdock, Sana, Plane, Apollo) — layout not applicable to a site drawer; used only to confirm empty-state suggestion patterns
Telegram, Dialpad, Etsy, Expensify, Framer, Gemini, AirOps — messaging or tool panels, not website assistants
GoDaddy, Gorgias, Zendesk admin — marketing or settings views of widgets rather than the widget in use
